explanation: It is often said Aida was written for the opening of the Suez Canal, but the canal and Cairo's new opera house both opened in 1869. The house opened with Verdi's Rigoletto.

claims.text: Verdi's Aida had its world premiere at the Khedivial Opera House in Cairo on 24 December 1871.
Aida's first performance was not in Milan, Venice or Paris; its European premiere was at La Scala, Milan, in 1872.
The Suez Canal opened in November 1869.
Cairo's Khedivial Opera House opened in 1869 with Verdi's Rigoletto.
Aida was not composed for the opening of the Suez Canal.
